description_en: Queries the details of a specified product
description_zh: 调用该接口查询指定产品的详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun iot query-product --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryProduct

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. On the Overview page in the IoT Platform console, you can view the ID of the current instance.

<notice>
If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no<props="intl"><ph> Overview page or</ph></props> ID is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ProductKey of the product to query. A ProductKey is a globally unique identifier issued by IoT Platform for a new product. You can view the information about all products under the current account in the IoT Platform console or by calling https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的产品的ProductKey。ProductKey是物联网平台为新建产品颁发的全局唯一标识符。您可以在物联网平台控制台或调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html，查看当前账号下所有产品的信息
parameters.name: product_key
